name: Quevedo

queries.query: Quevedo Ecuador official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry; Ecuador official cadastre parcel map GIS Quevedo
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Municipality of Quevedo site, an official municipal notice naming the Dirección de Avalúos y Catastros e Inquilinato and Registro de la Propiedad Municipal, and the official IGM Quevedo cartography/download page. No public Quevedo parcel viewer or anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was identified.

queries.query: Quevedo Ecuador catastro mapa predial visor parcelas registro de la propiedad municipal; servicio WFS catastro Quevedo
queries.result: La búsqueda en español confirmó la custodia municipal de Avalúos y Catastros y del Registro de la Propiedad, además del visor oficial IGM de Capacidad de Acogida. La configuración JavaScript actual del visor usa WFS temático de límites/capacidad de acogida, no predios; no se obtuvo una capa parcelaria pública con identidad nativa estable.

registryEvidence.custodian: The Municipality of Quevedo is evidenced as the local custodian reference: its official notice names the Dirección de Avalúos y Catastros e Inquilinato and Registro de la Propiedad Municipal de Quevedo.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This establishes local cadastral/registry responsibility, not a public parcel data service. The IGM sources are national thematic/cartographic services and were not treated as a local Quevedo parcel registry.

parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: A bounded anonymous WFS response was returned for v_area_cantones1, a thematic canton-area layer; it contained a MultiPolygon boundary feature and no parcel identity. It is not retained as a parcel sample.
parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as a citywide absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200. Official municipal notice dated 2024-03-28 describes a cadastral-management diagnostic and names local Avalúos y Catastros and Registro de la Propiedad offices; no map/API or parcel schema was exposed.

HTTP 200. Official municipal procedure page links to requirements/manuals for Avalúos y Catastros and Registro de la Propiedad via Google Drive; no anonymous parcel geometry service was exposed and no login was attempted.
HTTP 200. Official IGM Quevedo page exposes thematic cartography/geodatabases for Quevedo Norte and Sur, including land-use and socioeconomic products; it does not expose a parcel cadastral layer.

HTTP 200. Official IGM Capacidad de Acogida page links to the current viewer and identifies GAD Quevedo among 200 cities; this is a planning/thematic project, not evidence of a public parcel registry.

HTTP 200. Current HTML loads script.js. JavaScript inspection showed WFS requests only to igm_ca2022 thematic layers v_area_cantones1, organizacion_territorial_cantonal_v_4326, provincias_v1 and related project layers; no parcel/predio layer or parcel field mapping was present.
HTTP 200. WFS capabilities were retrieved and searched for parcel/predio/catastro layers; only thematic Quevedo-named layers such as v_densidad_pob_a_quevedo and v_geomorfologia_* were found.
HTTP 200 JSON FeatureCollection with one thematic MultiPolygon feature and a WFS-generated feature id; no parcel identity or parcel attributes. Not retained.
HTTP 200 response containing an OGC ServiceException for the attempted filter; treated as a query/filter failure, not evidence of absence.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if publicly exposed and source-proven
uncertainty: The local municipal cadastral and property-registration systems may be non-public or authenticated; no credentials or private fields were used.
The IGM viewer is current public thematic infrastructure but does not expose a parcel layer in its JavaScript/configuration or WFS capabilities inspected here.
The exact-point result, thematic-layer scope, and failed filter request are not citywide absence evidence.
No parcel polygon is retained because no stable native parcel identity and safe parcel geometry were verified.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter or runtime qualification.
